name: Kroschke GmbH
description:
Kroschke is a German company based in Ahrensburg that provides vehicle-related services, especially car registration and license plate solutions.
It supports individuals and businesses with online and in-person vehicle registration, deregistration, and documentation processes.
The company is a leading service provider in Germany for automotive administration and process management.
It focuses on simplifying and digitizing vehicle lifecycle services across the automotive sector.

name: COMLINE SE (Complement)
description: COMLINE Computer + Softwarelösungen SE (Complement) is a German IT services and consulting company focused on managed services/outsourcing, cloud transformation and security. In this CV context, it was the intermediary partner for the Kroschke engagement during the LinkPlus IT period.

name: Arbrea Labs
description:
Arbrea Labs is a Swiss MedTech and AI company based in Zurich.
It develops advanced AR, 3D, and AI tools for aesthetic medicine and plastic surgery.
The platform helps doctors and patients visualize surgical outcomes in real time.
It is known for its “medical metaverse” approach to improving clinical consultations.

name: Neundenker AG
description:
Neundenker AG (also known as konzeptler.ch) is a Swiss creative and advertising agency based in Switzerland.
It specializes in branding, marketing, digital communication, and web development services.
The company works on strategic consulting and creative campaigns for various clients.
It focuses on combining design, technology, and communication to build strong brand identities.

name: Eastside Co
description: Eastside Co is an award-winning ecommerce agency and Shopify Plus/Platinum Partner. It designs and develops Shopify (and Shopify Plus) stores, builds Shopify apps and supports ongoing ecommerce growth through strategy, UX and marketing services.

name: at-arbeit.net
description: Client website delivered on Shopify during the Opoware engagement.

name: Trackforce
description:
Trackforce is a global software company providing workforce management solutions for the security industry.
Its award-winning platforms, TrackTik and GuardTek, are used by thousands of organizations to optimize security operations.
The software supports scheduling, reporting, incident management, and real-time monitoring.
It serves security companies and enterprise clients worldwide.

name: Red Bull
description:
Red Bull is a global energy drink company known for its flagship energy drink product.
It is heavily involved in sports marketing, sponsorships, and extreme sports events worldwide.
The brand focuses on promoting an active and high-performance lifestyle.
It also produces media content through Red Bull Media House, covering sports, music, and culture.
